plan.title: RFQ Optional Terms Accepted by Vendor

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the required event title.
Create the Technical Stage and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required RFQ item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the Technical Stage first to verify RFQ-only clauses are not shown there.
Assert the first RFQ clause is absent from the Technical Stage.
Assert the second RFQ clause is absent from the Technical Stage.
Open the RFQ pricing round where the clauses should appear.
Confirm the first clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the second clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the first optional clause.
Accept the second optional clause.
Submit the vendor quote at 100 after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor bid was submitted.
Return to the buyer console.
Confirm the buyer sees the submitted RFQ response.
